keysDialog.heading: Connect keys
keysDialog.intro: Keys are encrypted at rest in data/keys.enc.json (the vault key lives in the macOS Keychain) and never sent to the browser.
keysDialog.replacePlaceholder: Paste a new key to replace
keysDialog.baseUrlPlaceholder: Default endpoint — set a proxy or gateway URL to override
keysDialog.footer: OpenAI and Gemini add image models; all eleven providers add chat models. Search keys power Design mode's web research; download tokens unlock gated models on the hubs. Local models keep working without any key.

mcpDialog.heading: Extend the agents
mcpDialog.intro: Tools from connected servers appear in Chat, Code and Design. Anything that can change something asks you first.
mcpDialog.emptyList: No servers yet. Add one below — for example an npx-run filesystem or GitHub server.
mcpDialog.footnote: ✳ marks tools that can change things; each of those calls shows an Allow / Deny prompt in the conversation before it runs.

settingsDialog.heading: Everything in one place
settingsDialog.noThemes: No saved themes yet — ask Design mode for one.
settingsDialog.usageLine: Last 30 days: ${cost} · {input} in / {output} out tokens · {images} images
settingsDialog.usageUnavailable: The usage ledger is not available yet.
settingsDialog.privacyBody: Local only — hard-disables every outbound call: cloud models, web search, page fetches, model downloads, key checks, and remote MCP servers. Local renders and Ollama keep working. Blocked attempts are listed in data/logs/.
settingsDialog.logsNote: Structured, secret-redacted, rotating at 10 MB in data/logs/.
settingsDialog.backupsBody: Sessions, projects, themes and settings live in data/safelight.db; the last 7 daily backups sit beside it. Keys stay encrypted and are never exported.
settingsDialog.licenseDetail: Covers Safelight {major}.x — issued {issued}. Thank you for supporting the product.
settingsDialog.licenseUnlicensed: Personal use — fully functional. Nothing is locked; a license records your support and covers updates for the major version you buy.
settingsDialog.licenseInvalid: That license file could not be validated.

modelManager.heading: Get models
modelManager.intro: Downloads land in the right models folder automatically, with checksum verification and a disk-space check.
modelManager.noResults: Nothing found — try another spelling or the other source.
modelManager.footerWithRoot: Models are saved under <mono>{root}</mono> where the render engine finds them.
modelManager.footerNoRoot: Models are saved where the render engine finds them.

library.exportBody: An absolute folder inside your home. It is created if it does not exist; sidecar metadata travels along.

codeWorkspace.emptyTitle: Point this session at a folder
codeWorkspace.emptyBody: Paste the absolute path of a project above. The model can then search, read, and edit files inside that folder — and nowhere else without your approval. Commands run only after you approve each one.
